description: DESTRUCTIVE. Deletes EVERY memory whose content contains the query as a case-insensitive substring — not semantic, not a single-item delete, and there is no undo. A short query deletes broadly. Use only when the user corrects a stored fact or explicitly asks you to forget something, and prefer a long distinctive phrase; check memory_state first if unsure.

query.description: Text to match against memories to delete

name: memory_forget
title: Forget a memory
